capabilities: Open supported ebook files in a built-in reader view
Switch between paginated and continuous scrolling modes
Adjust font size and choose from six reading themes
Search the full text of a book and browse a collapsible table of contents
Track reading progress, time spent and estimated remaining minutes in a bookshelf sidebar
disambiguation: Despite the name, it also reads MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ and TXT, and it never writes notes or annotations into the vault.
extras: README is in Chinese with English fallback in the plugin itself. Not yet listed in the community plugin store; installs via BRAT or manual download. Includes security hardening details (script stripping, CSP workarounds) and a guard against element re-registration conflicts with other foliate-based plugins. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by staff; minimum Obsidian version 1.7.2, mobile supported.
problem: Obsidian cannot open ebook formats natively, so reading them means leaving the vault for an external app.

relations.evidence: 阅读引擎基于 foliate-js（^1.0.1），使用 esbuild 打包为 CJS。

summary: Ebook reader that opens EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ and TXT files in the vault with pagination, themes, a table of contents, search and a progress bookshelf.
